scope: Same host, Python 3.12.2 and dependencies; separate fresh core processes and synthetic loopback fixtures. No real providers or personal profiles.
comparison: Medians of three independent p50/p95/p99 measurements; each run retains signed paired differences and nearest-rank percentiles.
source_hash_method: SHA-256 of sorted paths relative to src/selark, each followed by NUL and its file bytes; Python files only.

supplemental_chunked.comparison: One separate baseline/candidate pair; not included in the three-round reference medians.

validation.package: sdist -> wheel -> isolated installed environment; temporary CLI child processes run outside the source checkout
